instruction.text: Select the correct name for each device.
A work space with a desktop PC is made up of different parts. Drag the correct label to each part.

atoms.a: The computer contains the important components that let the desktop PC save files and run programs.
The mouse lets you move the on-screen cursor. The buttons on the mouse can select programs and perform a variety of other actions.
The keyboard can be used to write and perform actions like copy, paste and many more.
The monitor allows you to see the programs, videos or documents you are using the computer for.

hint.text: Electrical energy can be stored in batteries, which are used to power devices such as computers and mobile phones. A battery can always be recharged, even if it becomes weaker over time and needs recharging more frequently.
hint.label: Battery

atoms.b: In principle, laptops are ((++smaller bigger)), portable versions of desktop PCs. As they contain a ((++rechargeable AA)) battery, you can take them anywhere with you.
The different parts of a desktop PC are also found in ((++laptops printers)). However, they are ((++all never)) built into the laptop itself and are sometimes named differently.

instruction.text: Choose the correct label for the parts of the laptop.

hint.text: The touchpad is sometimes also called the mousepad. It is usually found below the keyboard and has the same function as a mouse.
hint.label: Touchpad
